newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia appoints JLW as property manager.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia appoints JLW as property manager.

text.p: The Australian government said on Monday it had selected Jones Lang Wootton (JLW) to manage 67 Commonwealth office buildings.
The offices were spread through the Australian states of Victoria, Western Australia, South Australia and Tasmania.
Administrative Services Minister David Jull said Jones Lang Wootton was selected from 10 tenderers.

"The calibre of all tenders was very high, but the selected tender offered the Commonwealth the best value for money," Jull said in a statement. "That means that we will be getting the best possible return on taxpayers' money."
The services JLW would provide included tenancy management and leasing, building maintenance, income and cost administration, energy management and performance reporting.
Jull said JLW was expected to start in the role on October 7, following negotiation of final contract terms.

The government estate is being outsourced in three groupings. Tenders for the second grouping, comprising 28 properties in New South Wales and Queensland, closed last Friday. Tenders for the final grouping of 29 properties located in the Australian Capital Territory will close on October 23.
